quarterly_data.quarter: Focuslight Technologies annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenue RMB 879,999,329.16, up 41.93% YoY; net loss attributable to shareholders RMB -38,409,574.27 (2024: RMB -174,909,485.17); net loss excluding non-recurring items RMB -73,980,118.51; operating cash flow RMB 172,313,728.20. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 169,523,549.92, Q2 RMB 223,242,523.11, Q3 RMB 220,590,355.90, Q4 RMB 266,642,900.23. R&D investment RMB 171,226,094.70 (+80.09%), 19.46% of revenue. The company attributes the remaining loss to R&D in optical communications, consumer electronics and pan-semiconductor, share-based pay of about RMB 4,081 ten-thousand, impairments of RMB 5,218 ten-thousand on inventory and other assets, the still loss-making Heptagon assets acquired in September 2024, and one-off restructuring costs.

quarterly_data.quarter: Focuslight Technologies annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Revenue by end market (annual report, 2025): optical communications RMB 6,602.54 ten-thousand, up 134.49% - the company kept its international customers while accelerating expansion in China, where some customers entered volume production in Q3 and the rest remain in validation; consumer electronics RMB 6,793.61 ten-thousand; pan-semiconductor RMB 20,554.81 ten-thousand (+18.91%); automotive RMB 15,861.55 ten-thousand (+99.86%); industrial RMB 26,454.00 ten-thousand (+14.29%); medical RMB 10,534.93 ten-thousand (+35.55%). By product: laser optics components RMB 393,652,632.54 (+37.01%, gross margin 42.74%), on pan-semiconductor, industrial fiber-laser and optical-communication demand; semiconductor laser components and materials RMB 143,575,113.38 (-4.28%). Main-business gross margin 35.39%, up 7.34 points; overseas main-business revenue RMB 465,961,405.42 (+54.78%).
quarterly_data.figure: optical communications RMB 6,602.54 ten-thousand (+134.49%); laser optics components RMB 393,652,632.54 (+37.01%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Focuslight Technologies annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Optical communications progress at end-2025 (annual report): the high-channel-count V-groove project (more than 36 channels) received positive feedback in customer module tests, with repeat and re-validation test orders, and some customers' validation met the high-precision requirements of their CPO assembly while the company prepared mass-production capability; co-development orders for etched micro-prism lens arrays with a major customer kept delivering, with the pilot line being built on plan; sample orders for precision molded lenses from several customers were delivered and small-batch orders were won. The company says it has started several NPO, CPO and OIO R&D projects with international companies, and that some pluggable-transceiver customers passed sample validation and entered volume supply. Its R&D project 'optical components for CPO systems' (budget RMB 460.00 ten-thousand) completed R&D-stage process validation and preliminary reliability validation.
quarterly_data.figure: V-groove more than 36 channels met some customers' CPO assembly precision; CPO optical components project budget RMB 460.00 ten-thousand

quarterly_data.quarter: Focuslight Technologies annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Other businesses (annual report): all of the company's disclosed lidar design-win programs with customer AG have been cancelled after AG's end customers dropped the lidar configurations - the first line-beam emitter program (expected lifetime demand about 50 ten-thousand sets) in April 2026 and the second (about 15 ten-thousand sets) in April 2025; lidar was about 0.83% of 2025 revenue and the company is negotiating performance obligations with AG. In advanced packaging, its laser-assisted bonding (LAB) systems won prototype orders from several advanced-packaging customers in China and Korea, received repeat orders and began small-batch delivery; it also developed, validated and delivered multiple customised DRAM wafer-annealing optical modules.
quarterly_data.figure: lidar about 0.83% of 2025 revenue; lidar programs of about 50 ten-thousand and 15 ten-thousand sets cancelled
